The '''''Hailene''''', in the [[Old Tongue]], "Forerunners," or "Those Who Come Before," is the term applied by the [[Seanchan]] to the massive expeditionary force sent across the [[Aryth Ocean]] to scout out the lands where [[Artur Hawkwing]] once ruled. Now under the command of the High Lady [[Suroth]], its numbers swollen by recruits from conquered lands, the ''Hailene'' has gone far beyond its original goals, and has in fact been succeeded by the ''[[Corenne]]''.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Hailene}}
